findings.evidence: Six buttons whose accessible name is only 'Compare' (dom-1440 buttons after h3 Claude, Perplexity, NotebookLM, ElevenLabs, Lovable, Gamma); a screen-reader button list gives six identical 'Compare' entries.
findings.after: <button aria-label="Add Claude to compare">+ Compare</button> (keep the visible word 'Compare' at the start of the name for 2.5.3)
findings.why: WCAG 2.2 2.4.6 Headings and Labels / 4.1.2 Name, Role, Value: identical names for different actions; the out-of-context purpose is unknown. Nearest curated card A11-006.

findings.after: Remove the badge in production, or add html { scroll-padding-bottom: 72px } so focused items scroll clear of it.
